Name: Futa Lovers Mobile Themes- Revamped
Author: rafinha20041
Description:
Second attempt, with hopefuly nothing that breaks TOS. 112 backgrounds, so 61 portraits, 60 landscapes (one is a repeat). There are exactly 24 Ai-Generated pictures in this mod. Anyways I made this for myself in 2024 and wasn't going to share until I saw user Vitey's "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38591]Futanari NSFW Themes[/url]" and saw that user [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/MortaliB/mods?gameId=1303]MortaliB[/url] gave'm permission to use his assets from "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12542]NSFW Mobile Themes[/url]". So I got [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/MortaliB/mods?gameId=1303]MortaliB[/url]'s permission and gutted his mod and threw the images I'd resized in. I've also drawn a QOS phone case, it looks neat. You can see it in the picture. Additionaly there is an optional QOS heart app icon that you can manually install, you just have to drag the two .pngs into your Mobile Phone's mods asset folder and replace the ones there. 

I've taken the liberty to delete some of the ones that looked worse-off as user[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/ErraticPixel] "[/url][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/ErraticPixel]ErraticPixel"[/url] mentioned on the last mods comments that a few didn't translate well into the new resolutions; As well as obviously deleting the stuff that violated the TOS from the previous mod from yesterday or today if you haven't gone to sleep yet. There were like 30+ deletions, so I made some new backgrounds, anyways, they should be better overall now. No longer Futas and A lil'more, now it's just the Futas. Everything should look even better than whatever you see in the picture/s since it's all zoomed in here, so there's that too. 

There is a version for Mobile Phone Continued, and one for the OG Mobile Phone mod, which is up to date, I trully don't know if they work in place of one another, but I do know they work as intended for their respective versions well enough.

The updated [url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1sJWOcQYAEZR4zPJjqydWdTPw2oJYW4Je?usp=sharing]google drive [/url]so yall can see exactly what they look like in game, sans phone case I suppose. Also so a poor Nexus moderator can ascertain as to weather this mod might have to be removed as well more easily. Sorry if you have to check Mr.Mod. 

If any artirts wish that I remove their work from this mod, I shall acquiesce. Main R34 artists are: Stretchybear, StevenCarson, Zyldark, Meis3D, Canvassolaris, and Method_Mad.
